sisi.depan: The monorail track curves gently towards a distant, colossal skyscraper with seven tiered joglo-style roofs, its dark structure illuminated by vertical lines of golden light that form a complex parang motif.
sisi.kanan: A cluster of interconnected residential towers features cascading green terraces on every level, transparent sky-bridges linking them, and holographic koi fish swimming in projected ponds on their glass-like walls.
sisi.belakang: The elevated track recedes behind the viewpoint, passing over a sprawling park filled with bio-luminescent flora and artificial banyan trees whose roots cascade down to the streets below.
sisi.kiri: A massive, low-domed building covered in glowing, geometric kawung patterns sits beside a multi-level market plaza where people gather under large, sail-like awnings.

tengah: A sleek, white monorail car with a pointed front, dark panoramic windows, and subtle gold trim glides away from the camera along the central magnetic rail.
atas: The pale sky is crisscrossed by the faint, shimmering trails of high-altitude sky-skiffs and a network of barely-visible energy conduits connecting the peaks of the tallest buildings.
